popCulture.title: Description of Greece
popCulture.creator: Pausanias
popCulture.description: Pausanias records the minority tradition that Euryganeia, not Jocasta, bore Oedipus' four children — a genealogical mercy that separates the incest from Antigone, Eteocles, Polynices, and Ismene.

popCulture.title: Euryganeia
popCulture.description: Alternative mother of Oedipus' children in Theban genealogy — daughter of Hyperphas.
